purpose: Expose one owner-only, read-only MCP tool for a sanitized Calapres operations-health snapshot without granting workflow management, customer messaging, commerce writes, or credential visibility.
activation_gates: Import as a new inactive workflow in the Calapres-owned n8n project.
Bind a dedicated OAuth credential that grants execute access to this workflow only.
Bind a separate health-reader header credential; never reuse Telegram, Chatwoot, Shopify, or n8n administrator credentials.
Deploy the health producer separately and verify it emits only the approved schema.
Verify exactly one exposed MCP tool named Get_Calapres_Operations_Health.
Verify success and failure executions store no payload data.
Run synthetic healthy, stale, degraded, unavailable, and redaction tests.
Obtain explicit owner approval before production activation or connector registration.
non_claims: This source commit does not deploy or activate the workflow.
This source commit does not prove current Telegram, Chatwoot, Shopify, analytics, or advertising health.
UNKNOWN and monitoring_unavailable are valid outputs and must not be rewritten as disconnected.
